title: Choose the honest recovery
when: When QA fails, its definition is wrong, a case cannot be performed, or a current gate remains unsatisfied.
need: Retry collects new evidence; correction changes the definition through supported currency rules; waiver records a justified exception; supersession requires a replacement obligation. None rewrites a failure as a pass. A corrected plan supersedes the post_deploy rows its new case replaced, and an item removed from its run retires a broken source in favor of the corrected one, so a corrected case that passes closes the item without a waiver. A stored replacement link that no longer answers for its obligation shows as `replacement_graph_invalid` on the plan read and the done gate, naming both rows and the repair: supersede with a passing same-scope case, or waive. A correction without an environment selector inherits its deployment-stage environment (persistent or run preview) and matches the admitted target scope. Plan drift reports count finished item and standalone snapshots as retained history, while listing actionable rows. Method-less acceptance requirements name qa.run.add with an explicit verified commit instead of a case runner. A supersession under a live execution restarts it on the current roster when no case has run; otherwise begin refuses `qa_roster_changed` and the next check-in refuses `qa_case_superseded`, each naming the exact `yoke qa plan abort` command, so a superseded case never runs. A plan correction reaches a live walk without an abort when the walk has not reached the case: the entry after the cursor is rebuilt, passed cases keep their results, and the walker stops at its next check-in with `qa_roster_corrected` until the same `yoke qa plan run` resumes it; a changed case at or before the cursor refuses `qa_roster_case_reached` with the abort command, and an unchanged answered copy never blocks the refresh. A committed abort or shared-stage settlement succeeds with shared_qa_wake_unavailable when its follow-up stage-wait read is unavailable; inspect the named deployment run and ask the control-plane operator to re-drive its QA stage. The warning does not undo the durable outcome. Item gate materialization keeps each attached plan snapshot stable across retries. For an explicit replacement, retain the failed case and add a distinct corrected key; when that key exists in the applicable current plan but not the snapshot, replacement_materialization_stale names the item, transition and project rematerialize command followed by the replacement declaration. Unknown keys, ambiguous cases and wrong obligation scope have separate diagnoses. Refresh updates matching rows, adds eligible cases and retires removed cases; a removed post-deploy case may already acquire its unambiguous automatic successor. Corrected code under the same case uses an ordinary retry without --replaces. Adding a case during a live walk refuses with the abort/retry command and rolls back the whole refresh.
surface: Named QA refusals; requirement state and correction reference
gap: Recovery depth exists but is scattered. Review question: should JOURNEYS add failed-or-stale-QA as a situation with a short agent diagnosis and one exact next step?
